text:
Maggie Chen: FYI — Ledgerwise (legal tech startup) just asked to onboard a custom multilingual summarizer (13B) into Private with HSM. They need PHI/PII redaction, per-tenant data retention, and a short eval plan. Also asking about a Dedicated trial to validate latency under 5s for 512 tokens.
Tom Alvarez: Thanks Maggie — I'm on the account. Renewal due in 10 months; this could push to Dedicated. Can you confirm scope (languages, docs types)?
Maggie Chen: They said en/es/pt + OCR-ed PDFs (legal contracts, opinions). Volume: ~12k docs/day initially. Sensitive PII present in clauses.
Ryan Patel: Ok — ML notes: 13B is fine if quantized; we should recommend 4-bit QAT or GPTQ if they want Dedicated cost savings. Need to know max seq len (are summaries from whole doc?)
Maggie Chen: They want whole-document summaries (avg 4k tokens, some up to 20k). Will accept segmented summaries but prefer a single coherent output.
Sophia Li: We should propose a hybrid: prefix-indexing + summarizer for >4k. Also offer prefix KV caching and automated chunking as part of Optimize suggestions.
Ryan Patel: For safety we need: (1) redaction pipeline before ingestion (PII/PHI detection), (2) eval prompts that include redaction cases, (3) hallucination/attribution checks. I'll draft an eval rubric.
Maggie Chen: Customer asked for the eval rubric and a sample harness they can run on-prem. Can we give them a curl example for a quick smoke test? Also ledgerwise needs SOC2 proof points and KMS/HSM integration docs.
Ryan Patel: Putting a minimal smoke test below — they can run against private deployment once we give access:
```
curl -X POST https://private.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"ledgerwise-13b-q4","input":"Summarize the following contract: <TEXT>","max_tokens":512}'
```
Ryan Patel: For automated evals, run: 200 examples across en/es/pt, include 50 with PHI tokens and assert redaction rate >= 99%, summary ROUGE-L >= threshold, and no verbatim PHI leaks.
Sophia Li: I'll schedule a 45-min enablement call with Ledgerwise to walk through the redaction workflow and the console billing/usage views. Suggest next week Wed or Thu.
Tom Alvarez: I'll confirm time with the customer. Also: can we offer a 30-day Dedicated trial with a test SLA? That would lower renewal risk if they like performance.
Maggie Chen: @Ryan — can you estimate infra for 12k docs/day with average 4k tokens? Need a rough GPU pool size for Dedicated quote.
Ryan Patel: Rough calc: if we chunk to 2k token windows and pipeline, ~6k requests/day * concurrency 50 peak => recommend 2x A10s or 1x A100 per shard with autoscale. I'll put numbers in a PRD.
Maggie Chen: Great. Action items: (1) Ryan: draft eval rubric + infra calc (ETA 48h). (2) Sophia: enablement invite + checklist for SOC2/KMS docs (ETA 24h). (3) Tom: confirm Dedicated trial ask + customer availability (ETA EOD).
Sophia Li: Added enablement checklist to the thread: bring sample PDFs, redaction policy, and a list of sensitive fields.
eval-bot: Canary scheduled by Ryan for model ledgerwise-13b-q4 at 2026-03-25T15:00Z — notify on completion.
Maggie Chen: Thanks team. I'll loop in Solutions & Security for the KMS/HSM scoping once Ryan drops the infra calc. :thumbsup:
Tom Alvarez: Noted. I'll update the account health doc and flag this as "potential upgrade" in the renewal tracker.
Maggie Chen: Closing loop here — will post customer acceptance criteria and the first eval results once we have them."
